subject: Compute DELTA15 plan: six owned selector gaps; explicit nil/refusal semantics
body:
Read integration DELTA9 missing list and current sources. Owned plan (compute files only):
- TeguComputeDevice name: keep existing stable METAL name, add a non-METAL fallback category with the same 'Nord2 Mali-G77'/'Tegu Mali GPU' string. No ABI change.
- minimumLinearTextureAlignmentForPixelFormat:: return 64 for the supported sized formats, 0 otherwise. No buffer-backed linear texture is implemented in this delta (newLinear and newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: stay explicit nil + bounded TEGU_SELECTOR_REFUSED); deviceLinearReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes stays 0 because arbitrary CPU-page/read-only import is not advertised. This is the real alignment a future exact 2D alias would require, documented as a capability gap.
- TeguQueue commandBufferWithDescriptor:: return ordinary commandBuffer; retainedReferences/errorOptions are safely ignored (no false ordering/retention claim).
- TeguCommand encodeSignalEvent:value:: no Tegu MTLSharedEvent/MTLEvent object exists; refuse explicitly, set sticky invalid + NSError, never forward to Apple or crash.
- TeguBuffer newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:: selector present, explicit nil + trace; exact alias not implemented (same staging/ownership risk as linear textures).
- TeguLibrary newFunctionWithName:constantValues:completionHandler:: call exact sync specialization once, then invoke handler exactly once with function-or-nil and NSError; synchronous bridge has no async compiler queue, documented.
Host tests extend check_frontend_delta5 release+one ASan; no phone/native/publish/commit. Heavy slot currently lowering; I will wait and run after release.
